danger_zone_desc: Permanently delete all your Agentys data: accounts, emails, learning profile, rules, history.
danger_confirm_body:
This action is irreversible. It will delete:

• Connected email accounts (Gmail, Outlook, IMAP) and OAuth tokens
• Synced emails, contacts, drafts
• Style profile ({{style}} entries)
• Corrections and learned rules ({{corrections}} corrections)
• Knowledge base ({{knowledge}} entries)
• Sorting rules and label history

Agentys will start from scratch — onboarding will be relaunched.

format_preview_question: Received email: "Hi, can we move Tuesday's meeting to Thursday? And could you send me the Q3 report?"
format_preview_body_concis_accessible: Thursday works. I'll send you the report today.
format_preview_body_concis_standard: Thursday works for me. I'll send over the Q3 report later today.
format_preview_body_concis_elabore: Rescheduling to Thursday suits me perfectly. I'll forward the Q3 report to you shortly.
format_preview_body_moyen_accessible: No problem moving it to Thursday, that works for me. I'll look at the Q3 report and send it your way this afternoon.
format_preview_body_moyen_standard: Let's move the meeting to Thursday, the slot works for me. Regarding the Q3 report, I'm finalizing the last details and will send it to you later today.
format_preview_body_moyen_elabore: I've duly noted your wish to reschedule our meeting to Thursday, which suits me entirely. As for the Q3 report, I'm working to finalize it and will forward it to you at the earliest opportunity.
format_preview_body_detaille_accessible: Yes, we can move it to Thursday no problem. I checked my calendar and the slot is free. For the Q3 report, I'm just finishing the last figures. I'll send it to you by this afternoon at the latest.
format_preview_body_detaille_standard: Thursday works for me, I've checked my calendar and the slot is available. That will give us time to cover the outstanding points. Regarding the Q3 report, I'm running the final checks and will send it to you by end of day.
format_preview_body_detaille_elabore: I can confirm that rescheduling our meeting to Thursday suits me perfectly. I've taken care to check it against my commitments and the slot remains fully available. As for the Q3 report, I'm putting the finishing touches on it and commit to forwarding it to you at the earliest opportunity.
